kus.question: Does the vibration record indicate a bearing fault?
paraphrases: Does the vibration record indicate a bearing fault? (variant 1)

kus.question: Which bearing component is faulted?
paraphrases: Which bearing component is faulted? (variant 2)
kus.T_template: The identified fault component is {component} ({tier} tier).

kus.question: What is the shaft speed of this record?
paraphrases: What is the shaft speed of this record? (variant 3)
kus.T_template: The shaft rotates at {rpm} rpm ({fr} Hz), from the tachometer channel.

kus.question: What outer-race characteristic frequency applies at this speed?
paraphrases: What outer-race characteristic frequency applies at this speed? (variant 4)
kus.T_template: At {fr} Hz shaft frequency the outer-race ball-pass frequency is {mult} x fr = {fc} Hz.

kus.question: Why was this verdict reached?
paraphrases: Why was this verdict reached? (variant 1)

kus.question: Which resonance band carries the diagnostic information?
paraphrases: Which resonance band carries the diagnostic information? (variant 2)
kus.T_template: The diagnostic band is {band} Hz (band kurtosis {kurt}).

kus.question: By what margin does the evidence exceed the competing components?
paraphrases: By what margin does the evidence exceed the competing components? (variant 3)
kus.T_template: The winning component's prominence is {ratio} times the strongest competing component ({winner} {win} vs {loser} {lose}).

kus.question: Which detection threshold applies to this verdict?
paraphrases: Which detection threshold applies to this verdict? (variant 4)
kus.T_template: The applicable threshold is {which} prominence >= {tau} on the band-scanned envelope spectrum.

kus.question: Is intervention needed?
paraphrases: Is intervention needed? (variant 1)

kus.question: How urgent is the intervention?
paraphrases: How urgent is the intervention? (variant 2)

kus.question: When should the bearing be rechecked?
paraphrases: When should the bearing be rechecked? (variant 3)

kus.question: Over how many harmonics does the evidence appear?
paraphrases: Over how many harmonics does the evidence appear? (variant 4)
kus.T_template: Characteristic-frequency evidence is summed over the first {kmax} harmonics with a {tol} Hz peak tolerance.

kus.question: Where is the fault located?
paraphrases: Where is the fault located? (variant 1)

kus.question: How does the fault position relate to the load zone?
paraphrases: How does the fault position relate to the load zone? (variant 2)

kus.question: At which position was the vibration measured?
paraphrases: At which position was the vibration measured? (variant 3)
kus.T_template: The accelerometer was mounted on the drive-end housing at the 12 o'clock position.

kus.question: In which part of the spectrum does the signature appear?
paraphrases: In which part of the spectrum does the signature appear? (variant 4)
kus.T_template: The signature is demodulated from the {band} Hz resonance band.

kus.question: Who should respond to this report?
paraphrases: Who should respond to this report? (variant 1)

kus.question: How severe is the detected condition?
paraphrases: How severe is the detected condition? (variant 2)

kus.question: Is escalation to the maintenance planner required?
paraphrases: Is escalation to the maintenance planner required? (variant 3)

kus.question: Who needs to act on a normal report?
paraphrases: Who needs to act on a normal report? (variant 4)
kus.T_template: For a normal report the operator continues routine monitoring; no specialist response is required.

kus.question: What action is recommended?
paraphrases: What action is recommended? (variant 1)

kus.question: How should the repair be verified?
paraphrases: How should the repair be verified? (variant 2)
kus.T_template: After replacement, repeat the envelope measurement and confirm the {freq} prominence falls below {tau}.

kus.question: How should monitoring continue afterwards?
paraphrases: How should monitoring continue afterwards? (variant 3)

kus.question: How was the confidence of this verdict established?
paraphrases: How was the confidence of this verdict established? (variant 4)
